profile.headline: Staff Research Engineer Google DeepMind
profile.summary:
I am an engineer, scientist, teacher, and author.  I am currently focused on using ML to solve OCR. 

Summary
2018 - Present: ML and Computer Vision research engineer at Google.
2017-2018: Ad analytics and influencer relationship management software startup. 
2016 - 2017: Senior engineer focused on applying NLP for matching people to job descriptions at Sourceress.
2015 -  : Software consulting specializing in web/mobile UI and data analysis infrastructure.
2014 - 2015: Upgrading legal research and analysis with Ravel Law.
2013 - 2014: Co-author New York Times bestselling book free+style.
2011 - 2013: Lead engineer solving financial visualization problems at Addepar.
2008 - 2010: IBM research fellow focused on building aspects of human neurobiology in silicon.
2002 - 2008: PhD research on measurement and visualization of white matter of the brain.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I lead video OCR research within Google Research. A small team focused on fundamental and applied research for video text extraction.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As first engineer, led development on many key areas of the Ad analytics and talent management software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Sourceress (YC 2017) is a new take on sourcing that is focused on closely calibrating to a hiring manager’s requirements, finding candidates who are a great fit using a combination of data science and human judgment, and then sending very personal reach outs that make sense. As a full-stack developer, I get to touch every part of this project, but my main contributions include the entire NLP pipeline for rating candidates (from the what to measure, to the solvers, to visualizers and  to the health monitoring of the entire system),  the initial architecture and algorithms for how trust/experience is calculated amongst raters (humans that rate profiles), an overhauled UI (using React, webpack, and friends) to handle our ever-expanding UI requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Offer full web stack assistance as well as mobile (iOS), but specialize in highly interactive front end web applications that are used to help people make inferences with their data.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: Helping Ravel create a new legal research engine empowering users with unique visualizations of the case law network. Lead the development of the flagship Judge Analytics feature that provides unique search and visualization for lawyers trying to analyze how a judge writes opinions. This feature also served as a template for our re-architecture of the front-end code. I also served a mentorship role for the younger developers on best practices as we transitioned the architecture.

positions.title: Engineering Team Lead
positions.description: Created and lead a 4-10 person team building the next generation user interface for Addepar. The interface involved creating a very powerful portfolio analysis and reporting tool using modern web UI technology. My team was also responsible for several popular open source projects (http://addepar.github.io/).

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: Worked across full development stack. Anything from first animations in the tool, to our first interactive web charts to being the principal inventor/developer of Addepar's financial graph data structure. The data structure was at the heart of Addepar's unique ability to create comprehensive and efficient aggregations of some of the most sophisticated financial portfolios.

positions.title: Post-Doctoral Fellow
positions.description: Continued my work in the cognitive computing lab on human inspired large scale connectivity of "spiking" neuron like processing units. Also explored a way to model standard CPU like APIs (add, multiply, etc.) from a network of spiking devices.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: At the cognitive computing lab, I explored methods for characterizing the white matter connectivity in the human brain in a way that may be informative to unique computing methodologies.

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description: Thesis: Measurement and analysis of the white matter of the human brain.

volunteerExperiences.description: Instructed and created various courses (iOS, React, and CS Algorithms) to assist CodePath's mission to offer high quality professional education to underrepresented folks in technology. My highlight was co-creating and teaching to sessions of over 100 students a course on fundamental CS Algorithms for tech interview preparation.

publications.title: Free+Style: Maximize Sport and Life Performance with Four Basic Movements
